elements.title: Accent Words + Eyebrow
elements.desc: Headline words rise with a spring stagger, accent words coloured, mono eyebrow above
elements.use: editorial hooks with 1-2 emphasised words

elements.title: Age Numeral Roll
elements.desc: Big serif numeral that rolls over on each cut (old rises and blurs out, new rises in), unit label below, last value italic accent. Use for ages, scores, years, counters tied to cuts.

elements.title: App Icon Launcher
elements.desc: 3x3 grid of generic rounded app tiles that pop in in a seeded random order (back-out scale + untwist), float, then one tile is tapped with a ring pulse while the rest dim. Use for "all your tools in one place" and launch/feature-grid beats.
elements.use: feature/tool roundups, "everything in one place", app-launch hooks.

elements.title: Article Highlight
elements.desc: Editorial paper card (section label, serif headline, byline, body) that blurs into focus, then a physical marker sweeps key phrases left to right behind the text in sequence, ending on a gentle zoom. Use for news/release/proof beats where the quote is the evidence.
elements.use: "as reported by", launch/trend proof, quoting a sentence that matters.

elements.title: Burst In
elements.desc: Animated text — one word at a time pops 0→100% with 115% overshoot while 14 accent rays shoot outward.
elements.use: title/hook words, impact reveals.

elements.title: Char Slam
elements.desc: Animated text — letters slam in one at a time (240% to 100%, ±7° tilt alternating) and STAY in place, spelling out the whole word before the loop restarts.
elements.use: punchy word build-ups, trailers, title reveals (a short word spelled letter by letter).

elements.title: Stamp
elements.desc: Animated text — three bordered rounded stamps, tilted -9°/5°/-4°, slam down one by one then fade together.
elements.use: approval / status labels, badges.

elements.title: Zoom At Camera
elements.desc: Animated text — word rushes from 6% to 100% (exponential ease-out) trailing three accent ghost layers, then blasts past camera.
elements.use: hero word reveals, shock titles.

elements.title: Stacked Slide
elements.desc: Animated text — three stacked lines slide in alternately from left/right with 18° skew that straightens; previous lines dim to 45%.
elements.use: multi-line slogans, teasers.

elements.title: Stretch Wave
elements.desc: Animated text — each character, anchored at its bottom, stretches to 200% height / 78% width and springs back in a travelling wave.
elements.use: playful titles, growth / height themes.

elements.title: Fly Through
elements.desc: Animated text — word holds then accelerates to 17× past the camera while the next word grows from 35% behind it.
elements.use: scene-to-scene word chains, tunnel feel.

elements.title: Drop Bounce
elements.desc: Animated text — accent word falls from above, squashes to 50% height, bounces ~20% frame height, re-lands lightly, settles, then crouches and launches out.
elements.use: landing/impact words, playful titles.

elements.title: Animated Text 09 · Giant Traverse

elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 10 · Row Counterflow (horizontal)
elements.desc: Five horizontal rows fill the safe height; rows 1/3/5 scroll left in main colour, 2/4 scroll right in accent colour, each with a slightly different speed.
elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 11 · Repeat Wave

elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 12 · Slant Bands

elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 13 · Curve Run

elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 15 · Depth Rows (horizontal)

elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 16 · Cross Tape

elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Flip Board

elements.title: Flip Card

elements.title: Slot Machine

elements.title: Googly Eyes Sticker
elements.desc: Googly eyes whose pupils swing like a damped pendulum re-kicked every beat; pop in with a spring; eye positions are props so it can sit on any face/subject. Pill caption slams in.
elements.use: comic freeze-frame, "stunning" reaction beats, mascots, product faces.

elements.title: Gradient Blobs
elements.desc: Blurred drifting brand-colour blobs (silk/aurora) as full-frame animated background.
elements.use: you want soft premium colour atmosphere behind text.

elements.title: Gradient Shine Text
elements.desc: Gradient-clipped text with a looping diagonal highlight sweep.
elements.use: hero word/brand name accent

elements.title: Grid Mosaic
elements.desc: 3x3 mosaic of tiles popping in on a fixed order, a word slamming per beat, then an in-cubic x3 zoom into the centre tile (transition into the next shot).
elements.use: Hard cut between shot sets, "many looks" hooks, montage intros.

elements.title: Halftone Cut Transition
elements.desc: Wraps children; around each cut the frame becomes ink dots on cream paper, dot size following luminance (CSS threshold trick). Use for hard cuts between clips that need a print-style flash.
elements.use: montage cuts on the beat, retro/print look

elements.title: Halftone Fade
elements.desc: Halftone dot field dense at the bottom edge fading to the top, behind a headline
elements.use: poster/editorial backgrounds

elements.title: Headline + Prompt Card
elements.desc: Headline with eyebrow + accent words, blurred app window behind, floating prompt card with typed quote and blinking cursor, two tilted pill tags.
elements.use: explaining a prompt/message/query, AI-tool style explainers

elements.title: Heart Counter
elements.desc: Glass pill with a heart outline that fills and pulses on each tick and an n/total count whose number rises in; for counting events (kisses, likes, wins)
elements.use: tallying repeated moments in a video with a corner counter.

elements.title: Heartbeat Push
elements.desc: Camera wrapper: lub-dub heartbeat scale pulses, slow push-in 1 to 1.07 and a diagonal screen-blend light sweep over children. Also exports Twinkle star.
elements.use: grid/collage/endcard reveals needing life

elements.title: Hero Accent Word
elements.desc: Italic accent word pops with overshoot, gold underline draws on, then a gradient shimmer sweeps through the text.
elements.use: one key word in a headline

elements.title: HUD Lock-on
elements.desc: Monospace character-grid readout: numbers roll through random glyphs then settle; corner brackets lock on in 3 steps with a tick.
elements.use: dev tools, spec walkthroughs, sci-fi/AI demos

elements.title: Ink Flood Handoff
elements.desc: Each glyph of a settled title dilates until the word fuses into a block, recolours and floods into the next scene panel, then the incoming title writes on. Use as a chapter or scene handoff.
elements.use: chapter breaks, title to scene transitions.

elements.title: Instant Replay Badge
elements.desc: Wraps a scene with an INSTANT REPLAY banner (skewed blue box, yellow hard shadow), rewind glitch/scanline look, then a slow-mo speed badge
elements.use: replaying a funny/key beat of a clip (rewind then slow-mo).

elements.title: Integration Beam
elements.desc: Three input paths draw down into a hub, glowing packets flow through it and on to a single output that pulses a green ring and check. Use for "many sources, one result".
elements.use: integrations, pipelines, automations, data flowing into one outcome.

elements.title: Iris Wipe
elements.desc: Shape mask (circle/diamond/square) grows from a point to reveal scene B over A.
elements.use: punchy reveal from a tap/button/subject location.

elements.title: Isometric Block Build
elements.desc: True 30-degree isometric cube stacks that drop in from 40px with a bounce, staggered diagonally, three tones per material, plus a leader-line label
elements.use: architecture/supply-chain/feature diagrams that assemble themselves.

elements.title: Judge Scorecards
elements.desc: Three held-up score signs rise on sticks with rotation; the last one droops with a bounce (sad). Caption pill slams in; optional sad-trombone cue marker.
elements.use: reaction / rating gags, review verdicts, comedy punchlines.

elements.title: Karaoke Captions
elements.desc: Word-by-word active highlight captions in 2-3 lines, anchored above the bottom 450px UI zone. Variants: atxt-41-karaoke-fill, atxt-43-ktv-two-line.
elements.use: spoken-word shorts, lyric/voiceover captions

elements.title: Keyword Highlight Sweep
elements.desc: Marker-pen highlight sweeping behind chosen keywords in a sentence, with colour flip under the edge. Variants: atxt-26-highlighter.
elements.use: emphasising 1-3 key words in a statement

elements.title: Kinetic Text Overlay
elements.desc: Transparent cue-driven text overlay - words rise in one by one with a soft shadow and an accent word, positions top/centre/bottom inside the safe zone - to lay over any footage. Use as the default caption/hook layer when the video itself is the star.
elements.use: hook words over footage, short statement cues, any "layer text after video" job.

elements.title: Kinetic Title Lockup
elements.desc: One word per beat slams in (heavy caps / big rotated italic / heavy caps) with a punch-scale cut each, then a locked-up three-line title springs up with a rotated pill. Use for hero titles and episode openers.
elements.use: opening title cards, hero hook titles, 3-part headlines.

elements.title: Letterbox Open
elements.desc: A 5:4 letterboxed band whose black bars open to full frame on a reveal moment, with a refocus
elements.use: cinematic intro that blows open to full screen on a drop or reveal.

elements.title: Life Timeline Dots
elements.desc: Timeline line across the top safe edge with N labelled dots, a filled progress line and a current dot that pops 1 -> 1.9 -> 1.35. Use for staged stories (ages, chapters, steps).
elements.use: a video moves through N stages on a beat (life stages, steps, eras) and viewers need a "where are we" strip

elements.title: Light Sweep Number
elements.desc: Near-black keynote stage, hairline grid, one giant count-up number revealed by a soft light sweep, one accent.
elements.use: product launches, feature stats, AI/SaaS headline numbers

elements.title: Hand-drawn Line Boil
elements.desc: Renders shapes as wobbly hand-drawn strokes whose jitter cycles through 3 seeded variants every 5 frames (on twos); demo shows anticipation, a leap and smear streaks
elements.use: playful characters, doodle explainers, social clips.

elements.title: Line Chart Draw
elements.desc: Line chart that draws on with an area fill, a travelling dot and a live value tooltip.
elements.use: trends, growth curves, revenue over time.

elements.title: Live Lower Third
elements.desc: Fashion-week broadcast lower third: blinking LIVE pill, location pill, season tag, camera flash bursts, sparkle stars, pink name bar sliding in with hard shadow and a mono subtitle bar.
elements.use: event / runway / premiere / celebrity-intro broadcast looks.

elements.title: Living UI Zoom
elements.desc: HTML/SVG-rebuilt app UI with eased cursor moves, pause-then-click, 1.6x camera zoom on the detail and pull back
elements.use: product tutorials, feature launches, changelogs

elements.title: Location Pill
elements.desc: Glassy dark pill with map pin, place name and a secondary line; slides in from the left, holds, fades up before the next cut
elements.use: travel/walk reels where each scene names its place (city landmark + local-language name or street)

elements.title: Logo Reveal Line
elements.desc: A line draws across, opens vertically to reveal a logo node, wordmark tracking collapses in.
elements.use: brand sting, intro/outro, sign-off.

elements.title: Logo Roster
elements.desc: Neutral glyph tiles land one at a time big in the centre, then drop into a growing row underneath, ending with a count pill. Speed-ramp entry. Use for a list of supported tools or integrations.
elements.use: "works with X, Y, Z and more" beats; supported tools, partners, integrations.

elements.title: Look Name Lockup
elements.desc: Two-line look name (serif italic + heavy caps with stroke) slamming in 4 src frames apart, plus a persistent LOOK 02 / 04 counter pill top-right. Exports LookNameLockup and CounterPill.
elements.use: Series of looks/variants/chapters with a running index.

elements.title: Lower Third
elements.desc: Name/title bar with slide+mask reveal and exit, placed inside the safe zone above the bottom UI.
elements.use: speaker/host ID, location tags

elements.title: Lyric Words Rise
elements.desc: Lyric/title line: words spring in (opacity, rise, scale, blur), each on a half-beat position proportional to its length; emphasised words heavy uppercase with accent glow.
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: Map to Globe Morph
elements.desc: A flat dotted world map folds into a dotted sphere: every dot lerps from its equirectangular position to its sphere position with a west-to-east stagger and a lift, while the camera pulls back. Use as a scene transition or reveal.
elements.use: "flat to global" reveals, section transitions into a globe scene.

elements.title: Map Outline Trace
elements.desc: Outline-only map: region borders trace on with the pathLength dash trick, faint graticule and contour rings, one region thickens and glows.
elements.use: minimalist/diagrammatic geography, border tracing, tech or editorial intros, "region X" emphasis.

elements.title: Marquee Ticker
elements.desc: Infinite seamless scrolling strip of text or logo nodes, deterministic by frame, either direction. Variants: atxt-14-multi-marquee.
elements.use: tickers, repeating keywords, logo walls, bands between sections.

elements.title: Masked Word Rise
elements.desc: Headline words slide up from behind their own mask, staggered; the default kinetic-title entrance
elements.use: hero headline / hook line, 3-10 words.

elements.title: Mini Strip Fill
elements.desc: Vertical 4-slot photo strip (top-right): on each flash a flash frame shows and a placeholder photo flies from centre into its slot with a spring
elements.use: photo-booth reels, "collect the shots" progress, gallery fill-ins.

elements.title: Modal Toast Ui
elements.desc: Window springs up, confirm dialog springs in, cursor arcs to the button with an eased move, button press dip, toast drops from the top.
elements.use: Fake-UI beat ("click to unlock"), reveal via interaction, app-demo gags.

elements.title: Model Switcher
elements.desc: A long row of tiles; a selection frame hops through several with a short beat on each, then settles green with a check and an AUTO name pill. Use for automatic selection or routing.
elements.use: "it picks the right one for you", model/plan/tool switching, A/B choice.

elements.title: Montage Hook
elements.desc: Rapid montage cut every 8 frames (coloured placeholder tiles) under a dim overlay; huge title slams scale 1.6→1 via spring; label pill.
elements.use: Reel openers/hook, 'one clip, many looks' intros.

elements.title: Mosaic Censor
elements.desc: Pixel-mosaic a rectangular region (children via SVG filter, or sampled colour blocks) plus a big "?" sticker, for spoiler-free covers
elements.use: spoiler-free thumbnails/covers, hiding faces or reveals with a guess-me "?".

elements.title: Negative Space Highlight
elements.desc: Text set in the empty region of an image; words reveal in sequence and one highlighted word gets a marker, colour and scale pop. Supports transparent alpha overlay.
elements.use: a photo has clear empty space (sky, wall, field) and a short quote or statement needs one word to carry the drama (5 s, MP4 or alpha).

elements.title: Notification Card Stack
elements.desc: Toast/notification cards slide in with spring and older ones step down a shrinking staircase.
elements.use: app notifications, social proof, alerts stacking.

elements.title: Orbit Ring
elements.desc: A hero tile pops dead centre and lifts; satellite tiles shoot out on drawn spokes and keep orbiting while a tick ring and a four-row dotted halo fill clockwise. Use for "connects to N things".
elements.use: one hub connecting many tools/models; ecosystem or integration hooks.

elements.title: Outro Lockup
elements.desc: Cream outro: logo slot (default abstract SVG mark), slogan and url springing in, with a short input fade.
elements.use: End of a clip/overlay piece, sign-off.

elements.title: Outro Title Stack
elements.desc: Two-line outro (heavy title scale spring, italic subtitle rising) plus a small credit footer fading in.
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: Overlay Scene Card
elements.desc: Transparent overlay: floating card (eyebrow + accent-word headline, spring rise) with pop tags, scheduled by beat ranges at 120 BPM, fading in the last 8 src frames; clip is a children slot. Exports OverlaySceneCards and SceneCard.
elements.use: Captions/explainer cards over a supplied clip.

elements.title: Paper Card World
elements.desc: Light off-white world with floating white rounded cards: four layered soft shadows, spring rise then gentle drift; dark only inside one card. Scene/layout shell for UI-style explainers.
elements.use: clean product/explainer scenes, dashboards, anything that should feel calm and premium.

elements.title: Paper Cutout Parallax
elements.desc: Layered paper cut-outs with white edges and hard shadows, stop-motion stepped at 12fps with a 24fps parallax camera and split-pin rotating joints
elements.use: music/fashion/kids/editorial scene backgrounds or hero scenes

elements.title: Particle Galaxy 3D
elements.desc: About 6000 additive point sprites in a three-arm spiral galaxy that reform (staggered, with a glow burst) into a ringed planet formation; camera drifts. Word-free.
elements.use: intro/transition backgrounds, hype beds, cosmic or tech themes, reform-to-ring reveal.

elements.title: Particle Glyph Assembly
elements.desc: Seeded particles spiral in from outside the frame and settle on the lit cells of a block-font word, then breathe. Targets come from a font grid, no canvas readback. Use for titles and slogans.
elements.use: hero titles, slogans, product names.

elements.title: Path Text
elements.desc: Text riding an SVG path, textPath startOffset sliding along it, optional outline
elements.use: curved/ribbon headline, wavy tickers

elements.title: Pen Follow Line
elements.desc: One ink polyline draws at constant 800px/s, camera pans to keep the pen tip mid-frame, closed loop floods with colour.
elements.use: minimal/luxury ads, whiteboard explainers, one-stroke logos

elements.title: Phone Mockup
elements.desc: CSS-drawn phone frame holding any children, with rise-in, idle float and 3D tilt.
elements.use: showing an app/UI/screen inside a device.

elements.title: Photo Counter HUD
elements.desc: Photo-booth HUD pill: blinking red dot and "PHOTO n/4" that ticks on flash frames, turns orange and kicks on a surprise tick
elements.use: photo-booth / burst-shot / countdown-style reels with a last-shot twist.

elements.title: Photo Grid Landing
elements.desc: Five white-bordered cards arc in from off-screen into a 3x2 grid with spring, rotation settle, landing squash and lagging shadow while a sixth shrinks from full-bleed into its slot; end-card collage
elements.use: closing a reel with a collage of 6 moments.

elements.title: Phrase Captions
elements.desc: Word-timestamped captions grouped into 2-4 word phrases that break on punctuation and pauses over 340 ms, with a per-word pop. Exports the pure groupCaptions helper.
elements.use: you have real word-level timestamps (transcription/forced alignment) and want captions that follow the speaker's breath.

elements.title: Phrase Scatter and Step-In
elements.desc: An old phrase holds, then each glyph lets go in turn (tilt, accelerating drift, fade to nothing) while the new phrase steps in word by word, with a punch on the warm italic emphasis word. Use for out-with-the-old, in-with-the-new copy swaps.
elements.use: replacing one message with another, "old vs new", rebrand reveals.

elements.title: Pie Chart Draw
elements.desc: Pie/donut chart whose slices sweep in clockwise, highlighted slice pops out, percentages count up, legend rows stagger in.
elements.use: share-of-total with 3-6 parts, market/traffic split, one slice to emphasise.

elements.title: Pill Toggle Morph
elements.desc: A dot pops in, morphs into a pill with a label, and its toggle switch springs on.
elements.use: settings/feature-on moments, UI explainers.

elements.title: Pixel Art City
elements.desc: Low-res night city drawn at 108x192 logical pixels and scaled 10x with crisp edges: banded sky, twinkling stars, 3-layer parallax skyline, blinking windows and a hopping character on the beat. Use as a retro background.
elements.use: retro/game/lofi backgrounds, music or tech intros.

elements.title: Pixel Dissolve Transition
elements.desc: Scene A breaks into square pixels: cells of B grow open in a seeded order (random blended with a diagonal sweep) with a glint on each cell. Use for digital, game or glitch-adjacent cuts.
elements.use: tech, gaming, retro, data scenes.

elements.title: Pixel Tile Materialize
elements.desc: An illustration sliced into tiles flies in from seeded scatter poses, then a red box hops and deletes cells by fragment burst or binary fill. Use for redaction, data-wipe and tech reveals.
elements.use: redaction, data deletion, glitchy reveals.

elements.title: Pixel Upscale
elements.desc: Draw a scene on a native 180x320 pixel grid (the 9:16 version of 320x180) with a 16-colour palette, then upscale x6 with no smoothing; includes sprites, dither, pixel font
elements.use: game trailers, nostalgia, year-in-review.

elements.title: Polaroid Strip
elements.desc: White-bordered stills rising with alternating tilt and stagger, as a thumbnail row or a fanned stack.
elements.use: Showing frames/moments, contact-sheet feel, freeze-frame payoffs.

elements.title: Pop Captions
elements.desc: Vertical-social captions (1-4 words) that pop on the spoken beat with a scale overshoot and one accent-colour word
elements.use: Reels/Shorts/TikTok sound-off hooks, tips, founder clips

elements.title: Pop-In Overshoot
elements.desc: Spring pop wrapper (scale overshoot) with configurable preset.
elements.use: chips, icons, stickers, cards entering.

elements.title: Poster Callout Lines
elements.desc: Poster cover with the hero shifted onto its own paper colour, many short phrases in empty paper, and fine curves drawing on as callouts and sweeps
elements.use: editorial poster/cover with a group or multiple-exposure hero and annotation-style phrases

elements.title: Process Flow Steps
elements.desc: Numbered steps joined by a connector that draws down between them; node lands, line draws, next node lands. Use for a sequence the viewer should feel as an order.
elements.use: how-it-works, 3-5 ordered steps, a workflow or recipe.

elements.title: Product Turntable
elements.desc: Procedural lathe bottle with a generated label texture on a turntable in a studio cyclorama, two lights, slow 360 with a hero hold. Label text is a prop. Use for product hero shots.
elements.use: product hero/reveal shots, packaging showcases (swap label text/colours).

elements.title: Progress Bar Line
elements.desc: Full-width bar along the bottom (or top) that grows linearly with the frame.
elements.use: Any reel/long scene: subtle global progress, countdowns, timers.

elements.title: Punctuation Zoom
elements.desc: The sentence's own full stop is the shared element: the camera pans onto it and dives exponentially (up to 72x) until the dot fills the frame and becomes the next scene, where a glyph tile bursts out a tilted picture card. Use for chapter changes and "and then..." reveals.
elements.use: chapter/section changes, punchline-to-scene reveals, "the full stop becomes the next shot".

elements.title: Push-In Camera
elements.desc: Damped virtual-camera push-in/pan with optional handheld drift applied to children.
elements.use: cinematic emphasis on a card/subject.

elements.title: Push Transition
elements.desc: Scene B shoves scene A off-frame in one eased move; A darkens, B lands from slightly oversize, and a shadow rides the seam. Use for clean sequential scene changes.
elements.use: chapters, before/after, step-by-step edits.

elements.title: Pyramid Tiers
elements.desc: Stacked trapezoid tiers that build bottom-up, apex lit in the accent colour, each with a label and a note. Use when the sentence is about levels or a funnel.
elements.use: a hierarchy or funnel (many at the bottom, few at the top), levels of skill, tiers of a product.

elements.title: Ranked Bar Race
elements.desc: Horizontal bars re-sort by value with rolling counters; rank is a continuous crossing so rows swap exactly where values cross. Use for leaderboards and period-over-period rankings.
elements.use: leaderboards, weekly rankings, market share races.

elements.title: Reel Cover Seam
elements.desc: 9:16 cover with a top and bottom image joined by a Ben-Day dot seam and big "10 -> 40" text kept inside the IG grid 3:4 crop
elements.use: before/after or age-A to age-B reel covers, publish-package thumbnails

elements.title: Region Map Highlight
elements.desc: Filled SVG map where the camera zooms to a target region, it fills with the accent while others dim, location markers drop in with pulses, then a stat callout.
elements.use: "an animated map of X", regional stat reveal, store/office/coverage spotlight, geographic transition.

elements.title: Ring Progress KPI
elements.desc: Donut KPI ring that fills to value/max with a counting centre number.
elements.use: single-metric callouts (completion, score, uptime).

elements.title: Ring Waveform
elements.desc: 72 radial bars around a circle reading the energy track at staggered delays ((i%24)*2 frames), alternating two colours.
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: Riso Halftone Plates
elements.desc: Two or three spot-ink plates built from halftone dots, multiply-blended on warm paper with 2-4px misregistration, stepping at 12fps
elements.use: indie/zine/event-poster looks, a printed hero backdrop behind type.

elements.title: Route Map Card
elements.desc: Rounded map card with stops at normalised positions, dashed route drawing up to the current stop, a ring gliding between stops, only the current stop labelled
elements.use: walk/trip reels showing progress between places (pair with `location-pill`)

elements.title: Running List
elements.desc: A list that stays on screen while the speaker works through it; each item arrives on the frame it is spoken and the newest is lit. Use over a talking head for "three things" scripts.
elements.use: a speaker names 3-4 things over several seconds; cutting away per item loses the thread, showing all up front spoils the reveal.

elements.title: Scene Edge Transition
elements.desc: Wrapper that warps or whips a scene in over its first 8 src frames and out over its last 8 (Warp/Whip from impact).
elements.use: Fast cuts between scenes in a reel; wrap each scene in its own Sequence.

elements.title: Scramble Decode
elements.desc: Left-to-right glyph scramble that resolves into the real text (hacker/decode reveal).
elements.use: tech/cyber reveals, labels, codes

elements.title: Selection Gizmo Box
elements.desc: Editor-style selection: pointer click selects an object, bounding box with 8 handles + rotate knob + axis arrows, drag to move, corner-drag to scale with live X/Y/scale readout, then swap the object.
elements.use: "edit the scene yourself" beats, cut-out/product swap demos, editor tutorials.

elements.title: Shape Morph Sequence
elements.desc: One SVG path morphs through a list of shapes via per-point interpolation; includes resamplePath helper
elements.use: brand stories, topic transitions, music visuals that transform instead of cut

elements.title: Shutter Close
elements.desc: Two black bars close from top and bottom (or left and right) with ease-in cubic, scene swaps under the closed shutter, then optionally reopens
elements.use: a hard "snap" cut between scenes or onto an end card.

elements.title: Side Lyric Words
elements.desc: Red lyric words either side of a subject's face on the eye line, pairs pop on beat with overshoot and hold to the next pair
elements.use: lyric/hook words beside a talking-head or portrait, synced to a BPM.

elements.title: Silhouette Text Outline
elements.desc: A word repeated along a closed outline path around a subject, scrolling continuously (SVG textPath startOffset loop)
elements.use: a subject cut-out with a repeating word ("LOVE", "WOW") hugging its outline.

elements.title: Slice Transition
elements.desc: Scene A is cut into slanted bands that slide out alternately left and right, center-out, to uncover scene B. Use for punchy scene changes.
elements.use: beat-synced scene cuts, energetic reels.

elements.title: Slot Refill Ticker
elements.desc: Lanes advance on one discrete step clock; a finished lane fills, its job icon exits right, and the next tick a new job takes the same lane. Use for queue, scheduler and throughput visuals.
elements.use: queues, schedulers, token or job throughput.

elements.title: Sonar Sweep Reveal
elements.desc: A clockwise sector beam sweeps a fixed pivot; the scene is clear inside the beam and dimmed behind a dark LED aperture grid outside it. Use for scan, radar or reveal moments.
elements.use: scan/radar/detect reveals, hero image unveils, tech intros.

elements.title: Sound Design Panel
elements.desc: Seeded waveform bar strip with a sweeping playhead, a cues.json code panel fading in line by line, and popping pills.
elements.use: Explaining audio/sound design, 'how it is built' panels, config/code call-outs.

elements.title: Spark Burst
elements.desc: Seeded radial particles with drag, gravity, shrink and fade; closed-form positions.
elements.use: celebration, impact, success moments.

elements.title: Speed Ramp Cut
elements.desc: Signature hard cut plus speed ramp: content is already visible and at peak velocity on frame 0, then a power4-out settle over 72 frames with no overshoot, with motion blur on the fast part. Exports speedRamp, speedRampStyle, RampCut and RampBlur. Use as the transition between every beat.
elements.use: every beat boundary of a white-ground explainer or product short; one dominant property per cut (scale, x/y or a small rotate).

elements.title: Speed Streaks
elements.desc: Anime speed lines: tapered white wedges rushing in from the edges toward a clear oval around the subject, re-seeded every 2 source frames
elements.use: spins, whip moves, impact shots on a subject.

elements.title: Splash Rings Word
elements.desc: Three staggered elliptical rings expand and fade while a big italic word drops from above on a damped spring.
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: Split Screen Slide
elements.desc: Two stacked halves slide in from opposite sides (expo ease, 3-frame offset) with captions and a pill between; then three vertical columns drop in and cycle content on the beat. Use for A/B looks or multi-shot montage transitions.
elements.use: comparisons, before/after-style intros, montage beats.

elements.title: Spoken Word Caption
elements.desc: Words light up as spoken (current word highlighted, past 100%, upcoming 50%), fading in and out around the line. Takes [text, startSec, endSec] triples.
elements.use: a single spoken line with word-level timing inside a scene.

elements.title: Stacked Half Panels
elements.desc: Two 940x580 cards stacked for 9:16, slid in from opposite sides and linked by one playhead sweeping both: top is the outline, bottom fills in behind the playhead.
elements.use: plan-to-result, before/after, prompt-to-output, any "this becomes that" beat for vertical video.

elements.title: Stamp Slam
elements.desc: Rubber-stamp text scaling 3->1 rotated -14deg with a red border and multiply blend, with impact shake and flash.
elements.use: verdicts, approvals/rejections, "no refunds" punchlines over documents or footage.

elements.title: Starburst Rays
elements.desc: Rotating rays from a centre point, plus a comic spiky white pop variant, both kicking on the beat
elements.use: reaction/pop moments behind a face or product, beat-synced.

elements.title: Statement Takeover
elements.desc: Footage dims under a scrim and one claim owns the frame; words land one by one with one accented word and a slow drift. Use for the single strongest line of a video.
elements.use: the one line that must land (a thesis, a claim, the hook payoff).

elements.title: Step Card Modal
elements.desc: White window card with traffic-light dots, STEP pill, heavy title and staggered arrow parameter lines; springs in from below.
elements.use: Explaining a technique/step over footage, how-to reels, feature call-outs.

elements.title: Sticker Arrow Callout
elements.desc: Die-cut stickers (14-point WOW burst, heart, round NEW badge) pop on beats with a white cut stroke, then a thick hand-drawn arrow draws on with a this-one tag and three sparkles. Use for playful callouts.
elements.use: social callouts, playful highlight of one thing.

elements.title: Subscribe CTA
elements.desc: Follow/Subscribe button: pop-in, press, ripple, state change to 'Following' with check and bell wiggle.
elements.use: social CTAs at the end of a reel; generic, no brand logos.

elements.title: SVG Stroke Draw-On
elements.desc: Draw-on any SVG path via strokeDashoffset using the pathLength=1 trick (no getTotalLength).
elements.use: logos, checkmarks, underlines, line-art reveals, signatures.

elements.title: Swipe Card Carousel
elements.desc: A phone-style card carousel with one owner of track position: a visible finger drags (linear), release snaps (decelerate), a next-button press advances, a last swipe lands. Focused card scales up, neighbours dim; two cards carry the owner headshots via SubjectFill.
elements.use: app/feature walkthroughs, step-by-step cards, onboarding swipes.

elements.title: Swiss Grid Type
elements.desc: 12-column grid with type that wipes into cells on one snap curve; one signal colour, hard-cut deletions.
elements.use: brand/event/conference openers, identity titles

elements.title: Terminal Insert
elements.desc: Flat, glow-free CLI window with traffic-light chrome that settles in with a perspective tilt, types a command, shows a big flat terminal word, streams "◇ ... ✓" rows and finishes on a success line with a blinking block cursor. Use for installs, agent runs and "one command" proof.
elements.use: CLI/install/agent-run beats, "one command does it" proof, dev-tool explainers.

elements.title: Time Pill Buzz

elements.title: Versus Split

elements.title: VHS / Film Era Overlay

elements.title: Wave Field Cubes

elements.title: Whip Pan

elements.title: Word Focus Rise

elements.use: Hard cut between shot sets, "many looks" hooks, montage intros.

elements.title: 網點切換
elements.desc: 一剪嗰下成個畫面變咗墨點印喺米紙上，點嘅大細跟住畫面光暗行 — 用於節拍剪接、復古印刷風嘅轉場。
elements.use: montage cuts on the beat, retro/print look

elements.title: 網點漸隱
elements.desc: 底部密密麻麻嘅網點慢慢散去 — 用於標題背後加質感，唔搶戲。
elements.use: poster/editorial backgrounds

elements.title: 標題加指令卡
elements.desc: 標題配浮出嚟嘅指令卡，逐隻字打出嚟仲有閃爍游標 — 用於介紹AI指令、示範介面。
elements.use: explaining a prompt/message/query, AI-tool style explainers

elements.title: 心心計數器
elements.desc: 每撳一下心心就填滿跳一跳，數字跟住升 — 用於計邊個中、幾多個讚。
elements.use: tallying repeated moments in a video with a corner counter.

elements.title: 心跳推鏡
elements.desc: 成個畫面似心跳咁噗通噗通，慢慢推近再掃過一道光 — 用於加緊張感、強調重點鏡頭。
elements.use: grid/collage/endcard reveals needing life

elements.title: 主角重點字
elements.desc: 重點字彈出嚟、畫線、再閃一閃光，直排橫排都得 — 用於標題入面最想人記住嗰隻字。
elements.use: one key word in a headline

elements.title: HUD 鎖定
elements.desc: 等寬格仔讀數，數字亂跳幾下就定低，四角框三步鎖死目標 — 用於科技感介紹、瞄準畫面。
elements.use: dev tools, spec walkthroughs, sci-fi/AI demos

elements.title: 墨水漫延轉場
elements.desc: 標題字嘅墨水膨脹、融合成一大塊，再漲滿變成下一幕嘅底板 — 用於章節轉場。
elements.use: chapter breaks, title to scene transitions.

elements.title: 即刻重溫標籤
elements.desc: 畫面倒帶花屏再慢鏡重播，標籤斜斜咁插入嚟 — 用於重溫精彩一刻。
elements.use: replaying a funny/key beat of a clip (rewind then slow-mo).

elements.title: 整合光束
elements.desc: 三條線畫落中樞，光點流過中樞去到單一輸出，輸出亮起綠圈同剔 — 用於「多個來源、一個結果」。
elements.use: integrations, pipelines, automations, data flowing into one outcome.

elements.title: 光圈轉場
elements.desc: 由一點開始擴大嘅形狀遮罩，將場景乙揭開 — 用於場景轉換。
elements.use: punchy reveal from a tap/button/subject location.

elements.title: 等距方塊砌起
elements.desc: 一舊舊等距方塊彈跳住由斜角砌起身，仲有引線標籤 — 用於架構圖、供應鏈同功能圖解。
elements.use: architecture/supply-chain/feature diagrams that assemble themselves.

elements.title: 評判舉牌
elements.desc: 三塊分數牌彈起嚟，最後一塊攰到垂低 — 用於比賽、評分、爆笑反轉位。
elements.use: reaction / rating gags, review verdicts, comedy punchlines.

elements.title: 卡拉OK字幕
elements.desc: 一隻字一隻字亮起嚟嘅膠囊字幕，貼住畫面下方安全位 — 用於口述短片、歌詞同旁白字幕。
elements.use: spoken-word shorts, lyric/voiceover captions

elements.title: 螢光筆掃字
elements.desc: 螢光筆喺關鍵字後面刷過，字色即刻反轉 — 用於一句說話入面突出一至三個重點字。
elements.use: emphasising 1-3 key words in a statement

elements.title: 動感字幕疊層
elements.desc: 透明、按 cue 列表驅動嘅逐詞升起字幕疊層，帶柔和陰影同強調詞，上／中／下三個位置都喺安全區入面 — 鋪喺任何片段上面做標題或鉤子字。
elements.use: 片段上面嘅鉤子字、短句 cue、任何「影片之後再疊字」嘅工作。

elements.title: 逐字重擊標題
elements.desc: 一隻字一隻字重重擊落嚟，最後砌成三行大標題，仲有粒斜斜嘅小標籤 — 用於片頭標題、爆眼開場。
elements.use: opening title cards, hero hook titles, 3-part headlines.

elements.title: 闊銀幕開幕
elements.desc: 上下黑邊一拍打開變全螢幕，仲帶少少對焦 — 用於開場揭曉、爆 beat 嗰一下。
elements.use: cinematic intro that blows open to full screen on a drop or reveal.

elements.title: 人生時間線
elements.desc: 一條線掛喺頂部安全區，點點逐個亮，行到邊個階段邊粒點就彈大少少 — 用於年齡、章節、步驟嘅進度條。
elements.use: a video moves through N stages on a beat (life stages, steps, eras) and viewers need a "where are we" strip

elements.title: 光掃大數字
elements.desc: 超大數字配一道光掃過再倒數上去，好有發佈會 feel — 用於產品發佈、功能數據同爆眼大數字。
elements.use: product launches, feature stats, AI/SaaS headline numbers

elements.title: 手繪抖線
elements.desc: 線條似手繪咁抖下抖下，兩格一變 — 用於古靈精怪嘅角色、塗鴉解說同社交短片。
elements.use: playful characters, doodle explainers, social clips.

elements.title: 折線圖畫出
elements.desc: 折線一路畫出，面積填色、圓點同數值提示跟住行 — 用於趨勢、增長曲線同營業額走勢。
elements.use: trends, growth curves, revenue over time.

elements.title: 直播字幕條
elements.desc: 閃光燈亂閃、粉紅名牌飛入嚟，仲有閃爍嘅「直播」標籤 — 用於時裝騷、首映、巨星登場嘅現場感字幕。
elements.use: event / runway / premiere / celebrity-intro broadcast looks.

elements.title: 活動介面放大
elements.desc: 重砌嘅介面入面游標慢慢行、停一停、㩒落去，再鏡頭拉近睇細節 — 用於產品教學、新功能發佈同更新日誌。
elements.use: product tutorials, feature launches, changelogs

elements.title: 地點膠囊
elements.desc: 玻璃感深色膠囊，圖釘加地名同細字，由左邊滑入、停一停、喺下個鏡頭前向上淡走 — 用於旅遊、行街 Vlog 報地點。
elements.use: travel/walk reels where each scene names its place (香港地標 + 區名或街名)

elements.title: 線條開標
elements.desc: 一條線橫畫過，豎直裂開，標誌同字標跟住跳出嚟 — 用於品牌片頭、片尾同簽名式收尾。
elements.use: brand sting, intro/outro, sign-off.

elements.title: 圖示陣容
elements.desc: 圖示磚逐個大大隻喺中間彈出，再縮細跌入下面不斷變長嘅一行 — 用於列出支援邊啲工具。
elements.use: "works with X, Y, Z and more" beats; supported tools, partners, integrations.

elements.title: 造型名牌
elements.desc: 兩行造型名先後重擊上屏，右上角仲有「造型 02 / 04」計數丸 — 用於系列造型、章節、款式逐個介紹。
elements.use: Series of looks/variants/chapters with a running index.

elements.title: 人名字幕條
elements.desc: 人名同職銜條仔彈出嚟，仲有直排版本 — 用於介紹講者、主持、地點標籤。
elements.use: speaker/host ID, location tags

elements.title: 歌詞逐字浮現
elements.desc: 一個詞一個詞浮上嚟，加埋模糊同縮放，強調詞仲會發光 — 用於歌詞片、跟節拍嘅字幕。
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: 平面地圖變地球
elements.desc: 平面點點地圖逐粒摺成圓球，鏡頭同時拉遠 — 用於轉場同「去到全球」嘅揭示。
elements.use: "flat to global" reveals, section transitions into a globe scene.

elements.title: 地圖輪廓描線
elements.desc: 只畫輪廓嘅極簡地圖，邊界逐段描出，一個地區加粗發光，標題直排 — 用於簡潔圖解式地理介紹、地區強調。
elements.use: minimalist/diagrammatic geography, border tracing, tech or editorial intros, "region X" emphasis.

elements.title: 跑馬燈字帶
elements.desc: 一條無縫橫掃嘅字帶，可左可右，仲有空心字 — 用於關鍵字滾動、分隔帶。
elements.use: tickers, repeating keywords, logo walls, bands between sections.

elements.title: 逐詞升起
elements.desc: 每個詞由自己嘅遮罩後面升上嚟，仲有直排版 — 用於爆眼標題、開場鈎子句。
elements.use: hero headline / hook line, 3-10 words.

elements.title: 迷你相條填滿
elements.desc: 右上角四格相條，每閃一下，相片由畫面中間彈入自己嗰格 — 用於拍貼亭、集齊相片嘅進度示意。
elements.use: photo-booth reels, "collect the shots" progress, gallery fill-ins.

elements.title: 彈窗游標通知
elements.desc: 視窗彈出、確認框跳出、游標彎彎地撳落去，最後頂部掉落通知 — 用於假介面搞笑位、「撳一下就解鎖」嘅揭曉。
elements.use: Fake-UI beat ("click to unlock"), reveal via interaction, app-demo gags.

elements.title: 模型切換器
elements.desc: 一長行圖示磚，揀選框逐個跳過，最後停喺其中一個轉綠色同打剔 — 用於自動揀、自動切換。
elements.use: "it picks the right one for you", model/plan/tool switching, A/B choice.

elements.title: 蒙太奇爆眼標題
elements.desc: 快剪鏡頭上面一隻巨型標題由大縮細重重擊落，仲有粒標籤 — 用於短片開場、一鏡多款嘅鈎子。
elements.use: Reel openers/hook, 'one clip, many looks' intros.

elements.title: 馬賽克遮罩
elements.desc: 將畫面一個長方形區域做馬賽克，再貼個大大嘅「？」貼紙 — 用於唔爆雷封面、遮臉、等人估嘅揭曉位。
elements.use: spoiler-free thumbnails/covers, hiding faces or reveals with a guess-me "?".

elements.title: 留白點睛
elements.desc: 將字寫喺相入面嘅空位，逐隻詞浮現，再將其中一隻詞打亮 — 用於金句短片、海報感開場、透明底疊圖。
elements.use: a photo has clear empty space (sky, wall, field) and a short quote or statement needs one word to carry the drama (5 s, MP4 or alpha).

elements.title: 通知卡疊
elements.desc: 通知卡一張接一張彈入，舊嘅會級級縮落去 — 用於App 通知、社交證明、提示疊。
elements.use: app notifications, social proof, alerts stacking.

elements.title: 軌道環
elements.desc: 主角磚彈出再上移，細磚沿住射線射出去繼續轉圈，刻度環同點點光暈順時針填滿 — 用於「連接好多嘢」。
elements.use: one hub connecting many tools/models; ecosystem or integration hooks.

elements.title: 片尾標誌
elements.desc: 米白底上面標誌、口號同網址彈入嚟 — 用於片尾、收尾簽名位。
elements.use: End of a clip/overlay piece, sign-off.

elements.title: 片尾雙行標題
elements.desc: 粗黑大標題彈出，副標隨後浮上，最底仲有細細隻 credit 淡入 — 用於片尾字幕、歌曲收場。
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: 浮動場景卡
elements.desc: 一張浮咗出嚟嘅字卡，小標題加重點字標題，仲彈出細標籤 — 用於喺影片上面加說明卡、懶人包重點。
elements.use: Captions/explainer cards over a supplied clip.

elements.title: 紙感浮動卡片世界
elements.desc: 淺色底、白色圓角卡片疊多層柔影，彈出後輕輕浮動，只有卡片入面先用深色 — 做 UI 風解說嘅場景底。
elements.use: clean product/explainer scenes, dashboards, anything that should feel calm and premium.

elements.title: 剪紙視差
elements.desc: 層層剪紙配硬陰影，12fps 停格加視差鏡頭 — 用於音樂、時裝、親子、編輯風場景背景。
elements.use: music/fashion/kids/editorial scene backgrounds or hero scenes

elements.title: 粒子銀河
elements.desc: 六千粒發光粒子旋成銀河，再重組成星環 — 用於開場、轉場背景。
elements.use: intro/transition backgrounds, hype beds, cosmic or tech themes, reform-to-ring reveal.

elements.title: 粒子組字
elements.desc: 一堆粒子螺旋飛入，砌成方塊字 — 用於標題、金句、開場。
elements.use: hero titles, slogans, product names.

elements.title: 沿線游走文字
elements.desc: 文字沿住一條 SVG 曲線滑行，可加描邊 — 用於彎彎曲曲嘅標題、波浪跑馬燈。
elements.use: curved/ribbon headline, wavy tickers

elements.title: 一筆到底
elements.desc: 一條墨線勻速畫落去，鏡頭跟住筆尖，閉合圈圈會灌色 — 用於極簡廣告、白板解說、一筆畫 logo。
elements.use: minimal/luxury ads, whiteboard explainers, one-stroke logos

elements.title: 手機框
elements.desc: 用 CSS 畫嘅手機框，裝得落任何內容，仲會升起、浮動、輕輕傾側 — 用於展示App、介面、畫面。
elements.use: showing an app/UI/screen inside a device.

elements.title: 影相計數 HUD
elements.desc: 紅點閃爍加「影相 n/4」，每閃一下跳一格，最後一張變橙色彈一彈 — 用於拍貼亭、連拍、最後驚喜嘅短片。
elements.use: photo-booth / burst-shot / countdown-style reels with a last-shot twist.

elements.title: 相片格子降落
elements.desc: 五張白邊相咻咻聲飛入 3x2 格仔，第六張由全屏縮埋位 — 用於片尾拼貼、回顧精華。
elements.use: closing a reel with a collage of 6 moments.

elements.title: 詞組字幕
elements.desc: 逐字時間碼分組做 2 至 4 個詞嘅詞組，遇標點或停頓超過 340 毫秒就斷，每隻字逐個彈出；輸出純函數 groupCaptions。

elements.title: 舊句散落新句踏入
elements.desc: 舊句一個字一個字跌散消失，新句逐隻字踏入，重點字用暖色大字彈一彈 — 用於「除舊迎新」文案轉換。
elements.use: replacing one message with another, "old vs new", rebrand reveals.

elements.title: 圓餅圖描畫
elements.desc: 圓餅／環形圖逐塊順時針掃出，重點一塊彈出嚟，百分比數字跳升，圖例逐行滑入 — 用於佔比分析、流量或市佔分佈。
elements.use: share-of-total with 3-6 parts, market/traffic split, one slice to emphasise.

elements.title: 藥丸開關變形
elements.desc: 一粒圓點彈出、拉成藥丸加標籤，開關彈一下就開咗 — 用於設定、功能開啟嘅一刻、介面解說。
elements.use: settings/feature-on moments, UI explainers.

elements.title: 像素都市
elements.desc: 108x192 低解像度夜景放大十倍保持硬邊：三層視差天際線、閃爍窗口同跟住拍子彈跳嘅小人 — 復古遊戲或 lofi 背景。
elements.use: 復古、遊戲、lofi 背景，音樂或科技開場。

elements.title: 像素溶解轉場
elements.desc: 場景 A 碎成一粒粒方塊像素，按種子次序翻開變成場景 B，每粒帶閃光 — 啱電玩、科技感切場。
elements.use: 科技、電玩、復古、數據類場景。

elements.title: 像素磚組合與刪除
elements.desc: 圖像切成磚仔由四方八面飛返位砌成，再有紅框逐格刪除 — 用於遮蓋、資料處理、科技轉場。
elements.use: redaction, data deletion, glitchy reveals.

elements.title: 像素放大
elements.desc: 將畫面喺細細嘅像素格仔度畫好再成倍放大，一粒粒方塊夠哂復古 — 用於遊戲預告、懷舊回顧、年度總結。
elements.use: game trailers, nostalgia, year-in-review.

elements.title: 即影即有相條
elements.desc: 白邊相逐張彈起帶少少傾斜，排成一行或疊成一疊 — 用於展示片段、定格回憶。
elements.use: Showing frames/moments, contact-sheet feel, freeze-frame payoffs.

elements.title: 爆字字幕
elements.desc: 一句一句跟住節拍彈出嚟，仲有一隻重點字著色 — 用於短片開場吸睛、教學貼士、創作者口播字幕。
elements.use: Reels/Shorts/TikTok sound-off hooks, tips, founder clips

elements.title: 彈出過衝
elements.desc: 彈簧彈出，大過少少先彈返定位，仲可以揀軟硬 — 用於貼紙、標籤、圖示、卡片登場。
elements.use: chips, icons, stickers, cards entering.

elements.title: 海報引線
elements.desc: 主角移落自己紙色上面，空位寫滿短句，再用幼曲線畫出指向主角嘅引線同裝飾弧線 — 用於雜誌感海報封面、群像封面。
elements.use: editorial poster/cover with a group or multiple-exposure hero and annotation-style phrases

elements.title: 流程步驟
elements.desc: 編號步驟之間有線畫落去連住：節點彈出、線畫出、下一步再彈出 — 用於有先後次序嘅流程。

elements.title: 產品轉盤
elements.desc: 車床造型樽身加程式生成嘅標籤貼圖，喺攝影棚弧形背景嘅轉盤上慢慢轉一圈再定格 — 用嚟做產品主角鏡頭。
elements.use: product hero/reveal shots, packaging showcases (swap label text/colours).

elements.title: 進度條線
elements.desc: 貼住畫面邊緣、隨時間慢慢填滿嘅細線 — 用於倒數、計時、顯示成條片行到邊。
elements.use: Any reel/long scene: subtle global progress, countdowns, timers.

elements.title: 標點放大
elements.desc: 鏡頭一路俾句子嘅句號吞晒，句號脹大變成下一個場景 — 用於轉章、「跟住嚟…」轉場。
elements.use: chapter/section changes, punchline-to-scene reveals, "the full stop becomes the next shot".

elements.title: 鏡頭推近
elements.desc: 虛擬鏡頭慢慢推近，仲可以加少少手持搖晃 — 用於重點卡片、主體特寫、電影感強調。
elements.use: cinematic emphasis on a card/subject.

elements.title: 推走轉場
elements.desc: 場景 B 一推就將場景 A 推出畫面，A 變暗、B 由略大沉落，接縫有陰影 — 乾淨利落嘅章節切換。
elements.use: 分章、前後對比、逐步示範。

elements.title: 金字塔層級
elements.desc: 梯形層級由下而上疊起，塔尖用強調色，每層有標籤同註解 — 句子講層級或漏斗時用。

elements.title: 排名長條競賽
elements.desc: 長條跟住數值升跌，自動換位排名，數字滾動 — 用於排行榜、週榜、數據對比。
elements.use: leaderboards, weekly rankings, market share races.

elements.title: 縫線封面
elements.desc: 9:16 封面，上下兩張相中間用波點縫線接合，中間大字好似「細路 → 大叔」，全部喺 IG 格仔 3:4 裁切範圍內 — 用於前後對比、人生階段 Reel 封面。
elements.use: before/after or age-A to age-B reel covers, publish-package thumbnails

elements.title: 地區地圖聚焦
elements.desc: 鏡頭拉近目標地區，個區填色、其他變暗，位置圖釘跌落嚟再彈出數據卡 — 用於地區數據揭曉、分店覆蓋、「某地動畫地圖」。
elements.use: "an animated map of X", regional stat reveal, store/office/coverage spotlight, geographic transition.

elements.title: 圓環進度
elements.desc: 圓環一路填滿，中間個數字同步跳上去 — 用於單一數據亮點、完成率、評分、在線率。
elements.use: single-metric callouts (completion, score, uptime).

elements.title: 環形聲波
elements.desc: 一圈放射狀嘅柱仔跟住音樂能量跳 — 用於音樂片、歌詞片、節拍同步嘅視覺。
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: 孔版網點
elements.desc: 兩三色油墨網點疊印喺暖色紙上，仲有少少走位 — 用於獨立雜誌、活動海報、印刷感背景。
elements.use: indie/zine/event-poster looks, a printed hero backdrop behind type.

elements.title: 路線地圖卡
elements.desc: 圓角地圖卡，景點按位置排好，虛線路線畫到而家呢站，光圈喺站與站之間滑行，只標示當前一站 — 用於行程、尋路 Vlog。
elements.use: walk/trip reels showing progress between places (pair with `location-pill`)

elements.title: 邊講邊起清單
elements.desc: 講嘢嘅時候清單一直喺度，每項喺講到嗰一幀先出現、最新嗰項亮起 — 用喺真人頭像上面，啱「三件事」類內容。

elements.title: 場景邊緣扭轉
elements.desc: 場景入面出面用扭曲或者甩動轉場 — 用於快剪、場景之間嘅爆炸銜接。
elements.use: Fast cuts between scenes in a reel; wrap each scene in its own Sequence.

elements.title: 解碼亂碼
elements.desc: 一隻隻亂碼逐個鎖定，最後變返真正文字 — 用於科技感揭曉、密碼、神秘訊號開場。
elements.use: tech/cyber reveals, labels, codes

elements.title: 選取控制框
elements.desc: 游標㩒一下揀中物件，出現八個控制點、旋轉掣同軸向箭嘴，拖移、縮放，數值即時跳動，最後換走個物件。
elements.use: "edit the scene yourself" beats, cut-out/product swap demos, editor tutorials.

elements.title: 形狀變身
elements.desc: 一條路徑逐個形狀變身，唔剪鏡，仲停定俾你睇清楚 — 用於品牌故事、話題轉場、音樂視覺。
elements.use: brand stories, topic transitions, music visuals that transform instead of cut

elements.title: 快門關閉
elements.desc: 兩條黑閘由上下（或左右）閂埋，閂實先換場景，再開返 — 用於一刀切嘅轉場或者收尾。
elements.use: a hard "snap" cut between scenes or onto an end card.

elements.title: 面側歌詞字
elements.desc: 紅色歌詞字企喺人面兩邊、眼線高度，跟 BPM 彈出嚟 — 用於人像MV、歌詞鈎子句。
elements.use: lyric/hook words beside a talking-head or portrait, synced to a BPM.

elements.title: 輪廓環繞字
elements.desc: 一隻字沿住主體輪廓重複排開，不停咁轉 — 用於貼紙式人像、「愛」「哇」呢類環繞字。
elements.use: a subject cut-out with a repeating word ("愛", "哇") hugging its outline.

elements.title: 切片轉場
elements.desc: 場景 A 切成斜角橫條，由中間向外左右交替飛走，露出場景 B — 用於夠勁嘅節奏切換。
elements.use: 跟拍子切場、節奏明快嘅 reel。

elements.title: 步進補位計數
elements.desc: 幾條通道逐步增加，滿咗就清空、彈走，下一步由新工作補位 — 用於排程、佇列、處理進度。
elements.use: queues, schedulers, token or job throughput.

elements.title: 聲納掃描揭示
elements.desc: 一道扇形光束繞軸心轉圈，光束內畫面清晰，其餘變暗成 LED 點陣 — 用於掃描、偵測、揭曉畫面。
elements.use: scan/radar/detect reveals, hero image unveils, tech intros.

elements.title: 音效面板
elements.desc: 一條波形帶掃過，旁邊代碼面板逐行淡入，仲有幾粒標籤彈出嚟 — 用於講解音效點整、「幕後製作」面板。
elements.use: Explaining audio/sound design, 'how it is built' panels, config/code call-outs.

elements.title: 火花爆發
elements.desc: 一嘭就爆出一大把火花，會跌、會縮、會淡出 — 用於慶祝、撞擊同過關嘅一刻。
elements.use: celebration, impact, success moments.

elements.title: 硬切加速度斜坡
elements.desc: 硬切即刻有畫面、第一格已經最快，之後用 power4-out 喺 72 格內慢慢收勢，冇回彈，快嗰段加動態模糊 — 用嚟做每個 beat 之間嘅轉場。
elements.use: every beat boundary of a white-ground explainer or product short; one dominant property per cut (scale, x/y or a small rotate).

elements.title: 速度線
elements.desc: 動漫速度線由四邊衝向主角周圍嘅空橢圓 — 用於旋轉、急停、爆眼重擊鏡頭。
elements.use: spins, whip moves, impact shots on a subject.

elements.title: 水花圈字
elements.desc: 三個橢圓圈擴散淡出，大字由上面彈落嚟 — 用於卡點、歌詞或擬聲字嘅重擊出場。
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: 分屏滑入
elements.desc: 上下兩半由左右兩邊滑入，跟住三條直欄跌落嚟隨拍子轉內容 — 用於兩款造型對比、多鏡頭蒙太奇轉場。
elements.use: comparisons, before/after-style intros, montage beats.

elements.title: Spoken Word Caption
elements.desc: Words light up as spoken (current word highlighted, past 100%, upcoming 50%), fading in and out around the line. Takes [text, startSec, endSec] triples.
elements.use: a single spoken line with word-level timing inside a scene.

elements.title: 上下雙面板
elements.desc: 兩張卡片上下疊成 9:16，由左右兩邊滑入，一條播放頭掃過兩張卡：上面係藍圖，下面跟住播放頭填色變成品。
elements.use: plan-to-result, before/after, prompt-to-output, any "this becomes that" beat for vertical video.

elements.title: 印章重拍
elements.desc: 紅色橡皮印章由大縮細「啪」一聲蓋落去，連震鏡同閃光 — 用於判決、批准、「冇得退款」呢類收尾笑位。
elements.use: verdicts, approvals/rejections, "no refunds" punchlines over documents or footage.

elements.title: 放射光芒
elements.desc: 由中心射出嘅旋轉光芒，仲有漫畫尖刺爆點版，跟拍子彈跳 — 用於反應、爆笑時刻。
elements.use: reaction/pop moments behind a face or product, beat-synced.

elements.title: 全屏金句
elements.desc: 畫面壓暗，一句重點霸佔成個螢幕，逐隻字彈出、一隻字用強調色 — 用於全片最勁嗰一句。

elements.title: 步驟卡片
elements.desc: 白色視窗卡有三粒交通燈、步驟標籤、粗標題同逐行彈出嘅參數 — 用於講解技巧、教學短片同功能標註。
elements.use: Explaining a technique/step over footage, how-to reels, feature call-outs.

elements.title: 貼紙箭咀
elements.desc: 貼紙隨拍子彈出嚟，跟住畫一條粗箭咀指住重點，仲有標籤同閃星 — 用於社交短片嘅俏皮標註。
elements.use: social callouts, playful highlight of one thing.

elements.title: 訂閱掣
elements.desc: 掣仔彈出嚟、俾人㩒落去、漣漪散開，再變做「訂閱咗喇」連鐘仔搖下搖下 — 用於短片尾嘅訂閱／關注呼籲。
elements.use: social CTAs at the end of a reel; generic, no brand logos.

elements.title: 線條畫出
elements.desc: 用 pathLength=1 嘅技巧一筆一劃畫出任何 SVG 路徑 — 用於標誌、剔號、底線同簽名嘅描線登場。
elements.use: logos, checkmarks, underlines, line-art reveals, signatures.

elements.title: 滑動卡片轉盤
elements.desc: 卡片轉盤有手指拖動、鬆手吸附、㩒下一個掣，聚焦卡放大，兩張卡用咗頭像相 — 用於功能導覽、步驟介紹。
elements.use: app/feature walkthroughs, step-by-step cards, onboarding swipes.

elements.title: 瑞士格仔排版
elements.desc: 十二格網格上，字一刀切入格仔，只用一種信號色、硬切刪除 — 用於品牌、活動同大會開場標題。
elements.use: brand/event/conference openers, identity titles

elements.title: 終端機插片
elements.desc: 平面、冇光暈嘅指令視窗，帶透視傾斜入場，打出指令、跳出大字、逐行串流「◇ … ✓」，最後一行成功訊息加閃動方塊光標 — 用於安裝、agent 運行同「一行指令搞掂」。
elements.use: CLI／安裝／agent 運行嘅畫面、「一行指令就得」嘅證明、開發工具解說。

elements.title: 時間藥丸震動
elements.desc: 鐘仔藥丸淡入、似電話咁震一震、停一停再向上飄走 — 用於場景之間標示時間（例如「朝早七點」）。
elements.use: labelling a scene change ("朝早七點") or a timeline of a day.

elements.title: 人後大標題
elements.desc: 大白標題夾喺背景同前景人像之間，由模糊慢慢變清 — 用於人像、產品封面嘅景深標題。
elements.use: portrait/product with a depth-sandwich title (subject cutout overlaps the letters).

elements.title: 垃圾桶丟棄
elements.desc: 三個通用 App 圖示由左邊彈弧飛入、旋轉縮細掉入垃圾桶，每下都撞到個桶郁一郁，上面嘅名稱逐個畫線劃走 — 「你唔使再用 X」嘅開場鉤。
elements.use: 「你唔使再用…」開場、換工具推介、大執屋／前後對比嘅鋪墊。

elements.title: 星光閃閃
elements.desc: 一粒粒星仔轉住眼閃兩閃，靚到發光 — 用於金字標題、暗底畫面加閃粒。
elements.use: sparkle accents over gold/hero text or on dark backgrounds

elements.title: 逐字打字機
elements.desc: 打字時光標唔會推跑版面，字一隻隻打出嚟 — 用於產品輸入框、提示欄同終端機一行行打字。
elements.use: typing inside an input/prompt box, terminal lines

elements.title: 速度模糊滑字
elements.desc: 文字高速掃過畫面，模糊長度同速度成正比，停低就即刻變清晰 — 用於快節奏單字交接。
elements.use: kinetic word hand-offs, speed-ramp feeling on type, UI "swoosh" moments.

elements.title: 新舊對比
elements.desc: 左右兩欄對比：左邊逐項睇完再劃走，右邊逐項填滿 — 用於前後、你我、舊法新法對比。

elements.title: 舊式錄影帶濾鏡
elements.desc: 幫畫面套上老戲院、錄影帶或手提攝錄機嘅年代質感，有顆粒、抖動同色偏 — 用於懷舊、MV 同神秘預告片。
elements.use: throwback, music-video, mystery teaser looks over any scene.

elements.title: 錄影取景框
elements.desc: 取景框加閃爍 REC、跑緊嘅時間碼同慢鏡讀數 — 用於慢鏡、幕後花絮、鏡頭視角。
elements.use: Speed-ramp / slow-mo moments, behind-the-scenes, camera POV.

elements.title: 液態扭曲轉場
elements.desc: 畫面似水咁扭曲再切入下一幕 — 用於想有軟綿綿波動感嘅換場。
elements.use: scene changes that should feel like a liquid wobble

elements.title: 水彩暈染
elements.desc: 墨線先畫出嚟，顏料再暈開、微微滲出線外，紙質有紋理 — 用於故事、旅遊、文化品牌嘅背景同插畫。
elements.use: storytelling, travel/nature, cultural brand backgrounds and spot illustrations

elements.title: 立方浪場
elements.desc: 二千幾粒立方體跟住節拍起伏，每兩拍射一圈衝擊波 — 用於音樂、爆點背景。
elements.use: music/beat backgrounds, drop moments, techno or product-launch bed under DOM text.

elements.title: 甩鏡轉場
elements.desc: 一下甩鏡帶模糊，A 向左甩走、B 由右甩入 — 用於快節奏、勁有勢嘅切換。
elements.use: fast energetic cuts between scenes

elements.title: 逐字浮現
elements.desc: 一詞一詞由模糊變清晰浮上嚟 — 用於字幕、歌詞、配合節拍嘅標題（有直排）。
elements.use: subtitle/lyric/headline lines timed to speech or beats

elements.title: 單字硬切
elements.desc: 全屏單字隨節拍硬切，換字、換色、換底同一格完成，最尾壓扁成一條線再彈返出嚟 — 用於節拍感強嘅宣言。
elements.use: beat-synced statements, hype intros, one-word-per-beat storytelling.

elements.title: 放大鏡標註
elements.desc: 鏡頭彈彈下拉近，放大鏡圈住重點再畫箭嘴標註 — 用於產品細節、教學指嘢。
elements.use: product/detail callouts, tutorials, fashion/detail reveals.

elements.title: 鼓點放大
elements.desc: 每個鼓點一下彈大，再彈返原位 — 用於跟住音樂拍子加重點。
elements.use: music-synced emphasis; pass beat frames from the beat grid.
